5.0.1 (pruned)

The vendored copy is pruned to the modules ARTIS uses (dense LU in nltepop.cc):

  Eigen/Core  Eigen/LU  Eigen/Version
  Eigen/src/Core  Eigen/src/LU  Eigen/src/misc  Eigen/src/plugins

All of src/Core is kept (including every arch/ backend) so that x86, ARM, and
GPU (nvc++/hipcc) builds keep working. The retained files are unmodified, so
simulation results are unchanged by the pruning.

Updating:
Download a release from https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/releases and copy
the directories listed above from its Eigen/ folder into artis/third_party/Eigen/.
Include <Eigen/LU> rather than <Eigen/Dense> in ARTIS code (Dense is not vendored).
